Coimbatore Corporation Geo-tags 1,500 OSR Sites in City

2026-08-24 Anushka Juliet, The Times of India Coimbatore, GIS mapping, geo-tagging, open space reservation, OSR sites, digital inventory, encroachment, municipal corporation, India
Read the source article

Quick summary

Coimbatore's municipal corporation has geo-tagged over 1,500 of its 2,702 open space reservation (OSR) sites through GIS mapping, creating a digital inventory to prevent encroachments and enable public access to land records.

Key takeaways

  • Coimbatore city municipal corporation has geo-tagged 1,507 of 2,702 total OSR sites through GIS mapping
  • The title-change process has been completed for 1,771 OSR sites
  • GIS mapping began in 2025, with around 500 parcels mapped in the initial stage
  • The database includes ward and zone details, survey and patta numbers, approved plot numbers, layout plans, and encroachment details
  • Drone imagery and field verification by licensed surveyors were proposed as part of the exercise
  • Once online integration is complete, residents can verify whether land is earmarked as OSR and belongs to the civic body
  • The initiative aims to protect public assets from encroachment and provide a consolidated database of reserve lands
